name: M1-4B-02, 1P
headline: Secluded & Bespoke 1 BDR Apt with Pool View & Beach access
summary: This Boho Chic 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with a 24/7 free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This Boho Chic 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with a 24/7 free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The apartment is on the ground floor overlooking the pool and features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 full bathrooms and a living room with a large sofa bed that can sleep 2 additional guests.  

It also features a 49 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & small families. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests a continued vibe of the already beautiful city of El Gouna.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Marina El Gouna. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

reviews.review:
We had an absolutely fantastic time!  It was the perfect escape and experience to fully relax and enjoy El Gouna.  The chalet was immaculate.  Clean, modern, spacious (definitely for a couple and enough if you have a child or two I'm sure or maybe another couple)... 2 full bathrooms with showers, all modern fixtures.  It was basically like staying in a very classy hotel.  All the amenities that you would need - all the kitchen appliances, cookware (although we didn't cook), a fantastic refrigerator/freezer combo that was tucked away into the modern cabinets in the kitchen, a big table with 4 chairs, a sectional couch, a good size HD TV w/Netflix and all the cable channels.  The master bed was extremely comfortable with a down comforter/duvet blanket.  The curtains blocked out all the light.  The bedroom had a full-length mirror and a garment rack for clothes.  The towels were soft and clean.  When it was time to open the curtains, you are facing one of the biggest sliding glass doors you have ever seen, absolutely amazing.  The view to the pool is right there in front of you.  2 sliding glass doors, one in the living room and another in the bedroom - both go outside to a seating area and from there it's just a couple short steps to the pool.  The pool - there are no words to describe the pool - pure perfection.  It is Huge and exceptionally clean for a pool that size.  Nobody bothers you and there is plenty of seating around the pool with lounge chairs and umbrellas everywhere.  From the pool, it's just a short walk to the beach area near the sea.   Getting around El Gouna is loads of fun riding in a Tuk-Tuk.  There are restaurants everywhere - downtown, the marinas...  It's absolutely beautiful to go walking through downtown and the marinas as well.  The Mangroovy area where the chalet is fairly new.  Everything was very well designed and taken into consideration.  

Christina, John and their Team took great care of us.  They made sure everything was perfect for our visit and beyond standard.  Great communicators and their local staff was available quickly for anything that is needed.  Extremely polite and professional and an absolute pleasure to deal with.

If you are looking for the perfect getaway to unwind and forget about the outside world for a while, then this is the place you need to be.  We can't wait to come back.   I hope this review helps some of you get the idea of what an incredible time overall we had in El Gouna.  I can really write more details, but the rest is up to you to explore!  Let your worries fade away as soon as you arrive and just enjoy every moment of your stay.  Good luck and have fun!  See you again soon!
